preconditions.description: The number of files n and the number of files to be deleted m are within the specified bounds.
The indices of files to be deleted are within the range of all files.

preconditions.expression: All filenames are non-empty strings containing only lowercase English letters, digits, and dots ('.').
preconditions.description: The filenames are composed of the specified characters.

preconditions.expression: The length of each filename doesn't exceed 100.
preconditions.description: The filenames are of reasonable length for the task.

postconditions.description: The pattern and each filename have the same length.

postconditions.expression: all(pattern[i] == filename[i] or pattern[i] == '?' for i in range(len(pattern)))
postconditions.description: Each character in the pattern matches the corresponding character in the filename, except where the pattern character is '?', which matches any single character.

postconditions.expression: all(filename in filenames_to_delete for filename in filenames_to_delete)
postconditions.description: All filenames to be deleted match the pattern.

postconditions.expression: not any(filename in filenames_to_keep for filename in filenames_to_keep)
postconditions.description: No filenames not to be deleted match the pattern.
The number of filenames that match the pattern is exactly m.
The number of filenames that do not match the pattern is exactly n - m.
The set of filenames to be deleted matches the specified indices.

postconditions.expression: filenames_to_keep == {filenames[i] for i in range(n) if i + 1 not in indices_to_delete}
postconditions.description: The set of filenames not to be deleted matches the indices of files not to be deleted.
